findings.issue: «palabra» narrows H1697 to the speech sense; the lemma also leaves matter/thing open and the morphology does not decide

Qal infinitive construct has no reflexive or object suffix; unmarked te is Spanish intransitive marking and does not add a participant, but pararse also admits halt/stand-up, which the bare infinitive does not decide
The imperfects and the two sequential perfects are one conditional chain; Spanish splits it into present haces/manda and future podrás/vendrá

notes: Si, te as the 2ms suffix, Dios, también, todo este pueblo, sobre su lugar, singular vendrá, and en paz match the tokens.
